## Root cause
In `Chess._moves()` (src/chess.ts), the pawn **single non-capturing push** computed `to = from + PAWN_OFFSETS[us][0]` without an off-board check — only pawn captures had the `to & 0x88` guard. A pawn placed on an edge rank (white on rank 8, black on rank 1) produced a `to` off the 0x88 board (e.g. h8 → 7 − 16 = −9). `_board[to]` is then empty, so the illegal move was added; during legality filtering `_makeMove` → `_movePiece` set `_board[-9]` and `_pieceKey(-9)` returned `undefined`, making `this._hash ^= undefined` throw `Cannot mix BigInt and other types`.

## Fix
One-line guard in `_moves()`:

```ts
if (!(to & 0x88) && !this._board[to]) {
```

Skips the push (and the nested double-push, which is never valid on an edge rank) when the destination is off the board. Matches the existing 0x88 check already used for pawn captures and sliding pieces.

- Full suite: **39 files, 465 tests pass** (`npm test` / `vitest run`).
